# Unmark

> Unmark cleans AI media: remove Gemini sparkles from images and videos, or cut out the subject. Free Instant image cleanup in your browser — Cloud for video, Library, bulk, background removal, and the Chrome extension.

Unmark removes the visible Gemini sparkle from AI images and videos, and cuts out backgrounds to transparent PNGs.

## Product

- [Unmark homepage](https://www.unmark.ink/): Instant cleanup in the browser, no account
- [About Unmark](https://www.unmark.ink/about): who builds the product
- [Product overview](https://www.unmark.ink/product): Instant, Cloud, video, and cutouts

## Tools

- [Instant upload](https://www.unmark.ink/#upload): drop a Gemini still or video
- [Background removal](https://www.unmark.ink/tools/background-removal): transparent PNG cutouts
- [Chrome extension](https://www.unmark.ink/extension): clean on Gemini and Google Flow
- [MCP server guide](https://www.unmark.ink/guides/mcp-server): connect Claude or Cursor
- [Agent skill](https://www.unmark.ink/skills): local-file cleanup for coding agents

## Limits

Unmark targets the visible Gemini / Veo sparkle logo. It is not a generic watermark eraser, and it is not built for Sora, Midjourney, Runway, or Adobe Firefly stamps.
